values.reason: Local hollow spots were found in the leveling layer, and the rechecked moisture content did not meet the installation requirements; corrective work is requested and the corresponding warranty retention is to be temporarily withheld

values.title: Leveling layer corrective-work request enters response period
values.body: Please provide the hollow-spot locations, two-meter straightedge readings, rechecked moisture content, and pressure-test records; do not begin installing the wood flooring until all requirements are met.
